mechanism.notes: 4R path J1-A0-A1-J3 with the elbow slaved by crank B from a third pin B0 on crank A to a pin B1 on the arm end. bodies: link 1, crank A (L-plate: A0, A1, B0), coupler (A1, J3), crank B, arm end (hub-3 lower plate + B1 tab + K7 neck). joints: J1, A0, J3 ACTIVE O20; A1, B0, B1 PASSIVE O20 pins; 1 loop (crank A - coupler - arm - crank B, a spherical four-bar in the arm frame; spherical Grubler 3 (6 - 1) - 2 x 6 = 3). Passives set by one loop root + the closed-form 2R: not sensed. custom: base, link 1, crank A, coupler, crank B, arm-end tab/neck, 6 hub shafts (est.); catalogue: 6 x MR117 pair (est.).
